jobs.description:
Job Purpose:  

* The Housing Navigator at THESSALONIKA FAMILY SERVICES will play a crucial role in assisting individuals and families in securing stable and affordable housing. This position is dedicated to providing guidance and support to clients navigating the housing market, ensuring they have access to the resources and information necessary to make informed decisions about their housing options.

  

Key Responsibilities:  

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' housing needs and preferences.
* Develop individualized housing plans and strategies tailored to each client's situation.
* Collaborate with local housing authorities, landlords, and property managers to identify available housing options.
* Assist clients in completing housing applications and gathering necessary documentation.
* Provide education and counseling on tenant rights, responsibilities, and budgeting for housing expenses.
* Monitor and follow up on clients' housing progress, adjusting plans as needed to ensure successful outcomes.
* Advocate for clients in negotiations with landlords and housing providers to secure favorable terms and conditions.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of client interactions and housing progress.
* Stay informed about local housing market trends, policies, and resources to enhance service delivery.
* Participate in community outreach efforts to promote housing services and build partnerships with relevant stakeholders.

Required Education:  

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Human Services, Public Administration, or a related field.

  

Required Experience:  

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in housing services, social services, or a related field.
* Proven track record of working with diverse populations, including low\-income individuals and families.
* Experience in case management and developing individualized service plans.
* Familiarity with local, state, and federal housing resources and regulations.

  

Required Skills and Abilities:  

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple cases simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Proficiency in using case management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex situations with empathy and professionalism.
* Knowledge of community resources and the ability to effectively connect clients to appropriate services.

jobs.description:
myPlace Health is built around a simple but powerful belief: older adults deserve the support they need to live safely, independently, and with dignity in their own communities. As a PACE (Program of All Inclusive Care for the Elderly) organization backed by SCAN Group, myPlace Health brings together customized medical care, social activities, and daily support for participants and their families – all under one roof.


Our centers are more than healthcare facilities. They are vibrant community hubs where participants are known by name, valued, and supported as whole people. Behind that experience is a dedicated, interdisciplinary team working together to coordinate care, remove barriers, and improve quality of life for some of the most medically and socially complex populations.


For employees, myPlace Health offers the opportunity to do deeply meaningful work in a highly collaborative setting. Team members are encouraged to contribute innovative ideas, and grow alongside a mission that prioritizes compassion, respect, and impact. The result is a culture where people feel connected—to their colleagues, their participants, and the communities they serve.


At myPlace Health, work is more than a job. It’s a shared commitment to honoring what matters most.


The Regional Home Care Coordinator is responsible for coordinating home care services and related support for participants to ensure services are delivered safely, effectively, and in alignment with each individualized plan of care. As a member of the Interdisciplinary Team, this role completes home\-based assessments, supports care planning, monitors service delivery, coordinates with contracted providers and community\-based resources, and provides nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice as needed.


The role also supports participant and caregiver education, documentation, quality oversight, and day\-to\-day coordination of home care services, durable medical equipment, and related needs. This regional position requires regular travel to participant homes and work from the PACE center to support care coordination, documentation, and administrative responsibilities across assigned sites.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Coordinate home care services through contracted agencies to ensure services are delivered in accordance with each participant’s individualized plan of care, authorized service needs, and program standards.
* Participate as an active member of the Interdisciplinary Team by completing home assessments, reassessments, change\-of\-condition evaluations, care planning activities, and ongoing review of participant home care needs.
* Provide nursing care within the Licensed Vocational Nurse scope of practice, including wellness checks, medication administration, wound care, and other assigned clinical services in the home, clinic, and day center as needed.
* Monitor participant condition and home care service delivery through collaboration with home care staff and external agencies, and report changes in condition, treatment concerns, or adverse reactions to the Registered Nurse, Physician, or other appropriate team members.
* Educate participants and caregivers on in\-home care needs, safety practices, and self\-management strategies to promote participant independence, well\-being, and continuity of care.
* Respond to participant and family questions or concerns related to home care services in a timely, professional, and service\-oriented manner.
* Schedule and coordinate home care visits and support related appointment logistics, including collaboration with transportation staff to ensure timely and accurate participant service coordination.
* Oversee and monitor services provided by contracted home care agencies to support quality, consistency, and compliance with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Document all nursing care, care coordination, assessments, and service\-related activities in the electronic medical record within established timeframes to ensure accuracy, continuity, and regulatory compliance.
* Support home care operations and team effectiveness by participating in care coordination meetings, updating care plans as needed, and assisting with the training and orientation of new home care staff.

* We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* Actively support the achievement of myPlace's Vision and Goals.
* Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

* Current, active Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) license in the State of California
* CPR and First Aid certification required within 60 days of hire
* Experience providing care to frail and elderly adults
* Travel 50% of the time covering both Downtown Los Angeles \& Compton locations
* Valid California driver’s license, insurance and reliable personal transportation
* Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment
* Proficiency in computer applications, typing, and electronic medical record systems
* Ability to maintain professionalism, exercise sound judgment, and respond effectively under pressure
* Demonstrated dependability, flexibility, and commitment to quality and ethical standards
* Compassion, patience, and respect in working with older adults and their families
* Prior experience in home care or community\-based care settings preferred

To ensure the health and safety of our members, if you are selected for this position, your job offer with SCAN will be contingent on providing proof of Tuberculosis screening upon hire or providing proof of a negative screening within the last year. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include coordinating outreach campaigns, managing community partnerships with schools, nonprofits, and local organizations, and organizing small events or presentations to promote nominations and kindness storytelling. The Coordinator will respond to inquiries from nominators and nominees, maintain accurate contact and outreach records, and lead fundraising activities such as donor cultivation, campaign planning, and grant research. The role also involves drafting outreach materials, social media and newsletter content, and collaborating with the team to develop new initiatives that strengthen community engagement and program growth.

Qualifications

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including the ability to present to groups, build relationships, and engage diverse community members.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to respond thoughtfully to nominators, nominees, donors, and partners, and to handle inquiries with empathy and professionalism.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to plan, organize, and track outreach efforts, events, and campaigns from initiation through completion.
* Candidates should possess Fundraising skills, such as donor stewardship, event\-based fundraising, and familiarity with basic grant or sponsorship outreach.
* Candidates should possess Writing skills for clear and compelling outreach materials, emails, social media posts, and newsletter content.
* Additional qualifications: demonstrated commitment to kindness, social impact, or community building; ability to work independently and collaboratively; comfort working in a small, entrepreneurial organization; proficiency with common office and communication tools (e.g., email platforms, social media, spreadsheets); and availability for occasional evening or weekend events in the Bay Area.
